liquidityDepth.metric: liqUsd (USD liquidity / reserve of the DEX pool backing the strategy)
liquidityDepth.uncomputableWhen: liqUsd null / SAMPLE (endpoint dead, uncaptured, unwired) → row outcome UNVERIFIED
liquidityDepth.notApplicableWhen: the vertical has no DEX-pool depth to screen (a lending market's exit is the protocol's available liquidity; a pure perp leg) → not-applicable

unlockOverhang.input: next-30d token unlock as a fraction of circulating mcap (DeFiLlama unlocks/emissions)
unlockOverhang.appliesWhen: the yield's reward token has a KNOWN unlock schedule
unlockOverhang.notApplicableWhen: no reward token / no unlock schedule found (a blue-chip stable market with no token overhang) → not-applicable (never a fabricated pass)
unlockOverhang.uncomputableWhen: a schedule exists but the pull is SAMPLE/absent → UNVERIFIED

counterparty.input: pool age (recorded /chart history span, days) + pool size (TVL, USD)
counterparty.rule: mature AND established → pass · both hard-flags (young AND dust) → fail · otherwise (a single hard-flag or a mid band) → caution
counterparty.label: structural screen (age · size · dependency) — NOT a contract audit; deep contract analysis is PARKED (the Sentinel IR)
counterparty.dependencyNote: an honest NON-SCORING note (the strategy's single-protocol reliance), never scored/over-claimed as a safety result
counterparty.uncomputableWhen: age (no recorded history) or size null / SAMPLE → UNVERIFIED
counterparty.overClaimBanned: the screen may NEVER render 'audited' / 'safe' / 'guaranteed' — a doc-lie wall failure (X-COVER / F-IDENTITY)

stablecoin-yield.liquidity-depth: applies (central — the DEX/LP pool's reserve depth = exit risk)

lending.liquidity-depth: not-applicable (a lending market's exit liquidity is the protocol's available liquidity, not a DEX pool depth)

delta-neutral.yield-reality: not-applicable (the yield is funding carry, scored by funding-regime)
delta-neutral.liquidity-depth: not-applicable (a perp leg's liquidity is the venue's, not a DEX pool — PARKED)
delta-neutral.counterparty: not-applicable (a perp venue's structural age/size screen is PARKED this sprint — honestly noted)

verticalApplicabilityMatrix.rule: n/a never counts toward SOLID, AVOID, CAUTION, or the UNVERIFIED-dominance count; it is shown as a distinct honest state (never a pass); a pair with no matrix entry is a Halt (the matrix must be total)

evidenceBundle.verb: ./organon.sh verify — regenerates the deterministic bundle and diffs it against the committed copy; a mismatch exits non-zero

artifacts.backs: the battery pass/fail count (N pass / 0 fail across M files)
'two identical runs' — the scorecard is deterministic (identical inputs → byte-identical output across two runs)
'the frozen seven git-clean' — the 6 .py + loop.ts are byte-untouched on disk
'the verdict differential reproduces' — lending fp-set 70c7912f… + funding NO-GO/ILLUSTRATIVE
the GeckoTerminal V-LIVE HTTP-200 capture (keyless; wired this sprint)
the manifest — every headline number the handoff cites → its backing artifact + value (evidence_bundle.test.ts asserts totality)

evidenceBundle.freshCloneRule: verify's diff-checked artifacts are environment-INDEPENDENT (the differential, the frozen git-status, the scorecard determinism, the battery count). The gitignored snapshot payloads are absent on a clone → the honest SAMPLE path; the live V-LIVE re-fetch is skipped offline (disclosed, not failed) — the committed capture stands. (A′#10.)
evidenceBundle.haltRule: a headline number with no backing artifact, or a verify that does not reproduce the committed bundle, is a Halt (X-PROVE).

deviationsSeed.why: it is a live integrity anchor (repro_contracts / F-ENV), not dead code — ripping out a live wall to satisfy a cleanup parenthetical is the very 'edit the integrity machinery' the record forbids

deviationsSeed.whatWasDone: the front-end is server-rendered Hono HTML (no Vite/SPA/bundler)
deviationsSeed.why: PART CLEAN's stated primacy — no heavy dependency; the cheapest correct thing a stranger can run AND read

stressCatalog.name: dead endpoint
stressCatalog.expect: degrade to last-good or SAMPLE; the served UI renders; never a crash/spin

stressCatalog.name: 429 storm
stressCatalog.expect: the short-TTL cache absorbs it; the Shelf reads the record (no per-load provider fan-out)

stressCatalog.name: stale cache
stressCatalog.expect: the shown asOf is the capture time, visibly stale, never 'now'; a verdict never rests on stale data while claiming freshness (OWN LINE)

stressCatalog.name: no-history pool
stressCatalog.expect: history-dependent rows (TVL slope · funding band · counterparty age) UNVERIFIED; point-in-time rows still compute; never a fabricated SOLID

stressCatalog.name: mid-session depeg
stressCatalog.expect: the peg row fires → AVOID; both registers agree; the moment captured

stressCatalog.name: emissions-inflated trap
stressCatalog.expect: the yield-reality row flags temporary → verdict not SOLID

stressCatalog.name: SAMPLE-heavy state
stressCatalog.expect: EVERY SAMPLE verdict is UNVERIFIED — the W-E01 invariant holds under the new axes too (a SAMPLE liquidity/unlock/counterparty value never yields AVOID) (OWN LINE)

stressCatalog.name: malformed / adversarial data
stressCatalog.expect: boundary-validated to missing/UNVERIFIED; never a crash or a nonsense verdict

stressCatalog.name: provenance tamper
stressCatalog.expect: a shown-but-unrecorded REAL Halts; a broken chain refused on construct

stressCatalog.name: determinism / no-LLM-in-verdict
stressCatalog.expect: identical inputs → byte-identical scorecard; a model-in-verdict rejected wholesale

stressCatalog.name: thin-liquidity trap (NEW)
stressCatalog.expect: a deep-APY pool with dust liquidity → liquidity FAIL → not SOLID; exit risk surfaced

stressCatalog.name: imminent-unlock trap (NEW)
stressCatalog.expect: a large near-term unlock → unlock FAIL → CAUTION/AVOID

stressCatalog.name: dust/new-protocol trap (NEW)
stressCatalog.expect: a young, tiny pool → counterparty flag, honestly labeled coarse (never 'audited/safe')

stressCatalog.name: verifiability (NEW)
stressCatalog.expect: ./organon.sh verify regenerates every committed evidence artifact; a tampered count or an unbacked handoff number fails

stressCatalog.name: coverage/applicability (NEW)
stressCatalog.expect: an inapplicable axis (funding on lending; peg on non-stable) renders not-applicable, never a fabricated pass; a claimed-but-absent vertical fails the coverage test

coverage.rule: each vertical is DISTINCTLY represented on the Shelf (stablecoin-yield is a stablecoin farming/stable-LP strategy, NOT a relabeled lending market) and scored with its applicable axes; a vertical named but absent is a Halt
